topic: Nail structure, growth, disorders, and diseases
author: codex-authoring-run-2026-08-13-nail-structure-01

why: The nail body is the visible nail plate. It rests on the nail bed and moves forward as new nail cells grow.
nail body（甲体）就是看得见的甲板。它位于甲床上，并随着新甲细胞生长而向前移动。
lock: nail body = visible plate on the nail bed.
nail body = 位于甲床上的可见甲板。

why: The free edge is the part of the nail plate that has grown past the fingertip. It no longer rests on the nail bed.
free edge（游离缘）是长出指尖之外的甲板部分，下面不再有甲床支撑。
lock: free edge = nail past the fingertip.
free edge = 长出指尖外的指甲部分。
refs: Nail Structure - Nail Plate and Free Edge

why: Verruca is the technical name for a wart. It is a raised skin growth caused by a virus and can spread to other people.
verruca（疣）是 wart 的专业名称。它是病毒引起的凸起皮肤增生，并可能传给他人。
lock: verruca = wart caused by a virus.
verruca = 病毒引起的疣。

why: Onycholysis means the nail plate has separated from the nail bed. Injury or an allergic reaction can cause this separation.
onycholysis（甲剥离）是甲板与甲床分开。受伤或过敏反应都可能造成这种分离。
lock: onycholysis = nail plate lifts from nail bed.
onycholysis = 甲板与甲床分离。

why: The free edge grows beyond the fingertip. This is the part that can be shortened and shaped with a file.
free edge（游离缘）长出指尖之外，是可以用甲锉修短和塑形的部分。
lock: free edge = fileable nail beyond the fingertip.
free edge = 指尖外可修锉的指甲部分。
refs: Nail Structure - Nail Plate and Free Edge

why: Cuticle nippers trim only loose, dead tissue. Cutting living skin can cause bleeding and create a way for germs to enter.
甲小皮钳只用于剪除松散的死皮。剪到活皮肤会出血，也可能让细菌进入。
lock: cuticle nippers = loose dead tissue only.
甲小皮钳 = 只剪松散死皮。
refs: Manicuring - Nail Implements and Cuticle Nippers

why: Ringworm is a fungal infection of the skin, not a worm. A nail technician should not work on an infected area.
ringworm（癣）是真菌引起的皮肤感染，并不是虫。美甲师不能在感染部位进行服务。
lock: ringworm = fungal skin infection.
ringworm = 真菌性皮肤感染。

why: Verruca is the medical word for a wart. Because a virus causes it, salon contact may spread it.
verruca（疣）是 wart 的医学名称。它由病毒引起，沙龙接触可能使它传播。
lock: verruca = contagious wart.
verruca = 可传染的疣。

why: Tinea is the medical name for a fungal infection. Ringworm is one type of tinea that affects the skin.
tinea（癣）是真菌感染的医学名称。ringworm 是影响皮肤的一种癣。
lock: ringworm = tinea = fungal infection.
ringworm = tinea = 真菌感染。

why: The nail bed is living skin under the nail plate. It supports the plate as the plate grows toward the free edge.
nail bed（甲床）是甲板下面的活皮肤，在甲板向游离缘生长时提供支撑。
lock: nail bed = living support under the nail plate.
nail bed = 甲板下方的活皮肤支撑层。

why: The hyponychium is living skin under the free edge. It helps block germs from reaching the nail bed.
hyponychium（甲下皮）是游离缘下方的活皮肤，帮助阻止细菌进入甲床。
lock: hyponychium = skin under the free edge.
hyponychium = 游离缘下方的皮肤。

why: The nail bed is the living skin that supports the nail body. The nail plate slowly moves across it as it grows.
nail bed（甲床）是支撑甲体的活皮肤。甲板生长时会慢慢向前滑过甲床。
lock: nail body rests on the nail bed.
甲体位于甲床上。

why: The matrix makes the new cells that form the nail plate. A healthy matrix allows the nail to keep growing.
matrix（甲母质）制造形成甲板的新细胞。甲母质健康，指甲才能持续生长。
lock: matrix = nail growth area.
matrix = 指甲生长区。

why: Onychocryptosis is an ingrown nail. The nail edge grows into nearby living skin and may cause pain and swelling.
onychocryptosis（嵌甲）就是 ingrown nail。甲缘长进周围活皮肤，可能引起疼痛和肿胀。
lock: onychocryptosis = ingrown nail.
onychocryptosis = 嵌甲。

why: Onychauxis is unusual thickening or overgrowth of the nail plate. The nail becomes thicker instead of simply growing longer.
onychauxis（甲肥厚）是甲板异常增厚或过度生长，指甲变厚，而不只是变长。
lock: onychauxis = nail plate becomes too thick.
onychauxis = 甲板异常变厚。

why: The hyponychium lies between the fingertip and the nail's free edge. This living skin forms a protective seal.
hyponychium（甲下皮）位于指尖与指甲游离缘之间，这层活皮肤形成保护性密封。
lock: free edge underneath = hyponychium.
游离缘下方 = 甲下皮。

why: Onychorrhexis describes nails that split easily and have lengthwise ridges. Gentle service helps avoid making the splitting worse.
onychorrhexis（甲纵裂）指容易裂开并有纵向纹路的指甲。操作要轻柔，避免裂纹加重。
lock: onychorrhexis = split, brittle, ridged nails.
onychorrhexis = 易裂、脆弱、有纵纹的指甲。

why: Leukonychia appears as white spots inside the nail plate. Small injuries to the matrix commonly cause these spots.
leukonychia（甲白斑）表现为甲板内的白点，通常由甲母质受到轻微损伤引起。
lock: leukonychia = white spots in the nail plate.
leukonychia = 甲板内的白点。

why: Onyx is the scientific name for the natural nail. The word refers to the hard nail plate made mainly of keratin.
onyx 是天然指甲的科学名称，指主要由角蛋白组成的坚硬甲板。
lock: onyx = natural nail.
onyx = 天然指甲。

why: Nail growth slows with age, and older nails often hold less water. Less water makes the nail more brittle.
随着年龄增长，指甲生长会变慢，而且含水量常会减少。水分少会让指甲更脆。
lock: older nails = slower growth and more brittleness.
老年指甲 = 生长较慢，也更脆。

why: Greenish-yellow color under an artificial nail often comes from bacterial growth in trapped moisture. Remove the product and do not cover the area again.
人工甲下出现黄绿色，常是细菌在被困住的水分中生长造成的。应卸除产品，不要再次覆盖该处。
lock: green under an enhancement = suspect bacteria.
人工甲下发绿 = 怀疑细菌生长。

why: Fungal infections can spread and are outside a nail technician's work. Refuse the service and refer the client to a doctor.
真菌感染可能传播，也不属于美甲师的处理范围。应拒绝服务，并建议客户就医。
lock: suspected fungus = no service; refer to a doctor.
怀疑真菌感染 = 不服务，建议就医。

why: A healthy nail contains some water, so it can bend slightly without breaking. A nail that is too dry becomes hard and brittle.
健康指甲含有一定水分，因此可以轻微弯曲而不断裂。指甲太干会变硬、变脆。
lock: healthy nail = firm but flexible.
健康指甲 = 坚实但有弹性。
refs: Nail Structure - Water Content and Flexibility

why: Water helps the nail plate bend. When the nail holds less water, it becomes harder and less flexible.
水分帮助甲板弯曲。指甲含水量越低，就会越硬，越不容易弯曲。
lock: less nail water = harder nail.
指甲水分越少 = 指甲越硬。
refs: Nail Structure - Water Content and Flexibility

why: The cuticle is dead tissue attached to the nail plate. It seals the gap where the plate meets living skin and helps block germs.
cuticle（甲小皮）是附着在甲板上的死皮。它封住甲板与活皮肤之间的缝隙，帮助阻挡细菌。
lock: cuticle = dead seal on the nail plate.
cuticle = 甲板上的死皮密封层。

why: The proximal nail fold is living skin that covers the matrix and part of the nail plate. The cuticle is dead tissue stuck to the plate.
proximal nail fold（近端甲襞）是覆盖甲母质和部分甲板的活皮肤；cuticle 是附着在甲板上的死皮。
lock: nail fold = living skin; cuticle = dead tissue.
甲襞 = 活皮肤；cuticle = 死皮。
refs: Nail Structure - Proximal Nail Fold and Cuticle

why: Tinea pedis is a fungal infection of the feet. Because it can spread, a nail technician must not perform a service on it.
tinea pedis（足癣）是真菌性足部感染。它可能传播，所以美甲师不能在感染部位进行服务。
lock: tinea pedis = contagious foot fungus.
tinea pedis = 可传染的足部真菌感染。

why: An ingrown toenail grows into living skin and may become infected. Nail technicians do not treat it; the client needs medical care.
嵌甲会长进活皮肤，并可能发生感染。美甲师不能处理，客户需要接受医疗护理。
lock: ingrown toenail = no salon service.
嵌甲 = 不进行沙龙服务。

notes: All candidates remain unreviewed. Three source items were quarantined because their wording or keyed diagnosis is not safe to teach as written.
